salesLanguage.headline: RXV-70-4K-ARC: gets the signal from one place to another without moving the equipment
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the source, display, USB device or control point is too far away for a simple local cable.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It lets the room be built around where people and displays need to be, rather than where short cables happen to reach.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Displays away from the rack, lecterns, teaching rooms, meeting rooms and point-to-point signal paths.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Start with distance and what has to travel: video only, video plus USB, audio, control or network.
talkTrack: It solves a distance problem.
Use it when the video path needs reliable point-to-point extension.
It is usually simpler than AV-over-IP when the path is one source to one display.
discoveryPrompts: How far is the source from the display or USB device?
What signals need to travel over the same path?
Is this a single fixed route or does it need to switch between many destinations?
avoidPositioningAs: Do not use an extender as a routing system when many sources and many displays need flexible switching.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

With high-framerate HDR-10 and HLG technology exceeding the capabilities of HDBaseT, WyreStorm has implemented light-compression technology. The RXV-70-4K-ARC forms part of this new generation of signal extension technology and furthermore, frees the 5.1 audio from an ARC compatible TV and sends back to an H2XC matrix over HDBaseT; an optical S/PDIF input is also present for sending digital audio signals.
Audio Return is selectable between HDMI or S/PDIF optical input which allows for audio from a TV without ARC support to send audio to the transmitter or matrix.
Receives HDBT transmissions of 4K up to 70m/230ft and 1080p up to 100m/328ft with multi-channel audio, control, ethernet and PoH also supported
Supports ARC via HDMI or optical input for audio return over HDBaseT
Compatible with HDR standards including HDR-10, HDR-10+, HLG and Dolby Vision TM (Dolby Vision supported up to 30Hz)
Class A HDBaseT supporting the transmission of video, multichannel audio, Ethernet, bidirectional control and PoH
Bidirectional IR supported with both IR TX & RX ports
Supports Ethernet pass-through from matrix (Class A HDBaseT transmission only)
Wall mounting brackets and IR accessories included
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | CEC | DVI-D supported with adapter (not included)
Supports True ARC (via HDMI) or S/PDIF optical return from display to the matrix over HDBaseT
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
